question: 数据库中一共有多少个地区？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS region_count FROM regions

question: 列出所有地区名称并按名称排序。
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM regions ORDER BY name

question: 一共有多少名客户？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

question: 一共有多少种商品？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products

question: 列出所有商品名称和售价，价格从高到低排序。
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, name

question: 价格最高的商品是什么，价格是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, name LIMIT 1

question: 价格最低的商品是什么，价格是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC, name LIMIT 1

question: 分别统计 paid、cancelled 和 pending 状态的订单数量。
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: 已支付订单一共有多少笔？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

question: 有多少订单还没有支付时间？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaid_order_count FROM orders WHERE paid_at IS NULL

question: 统计每个地区的客户数量，按客户数量从高到低排序。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, COUNT(c.id) AS customer_count FROM regions r LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY customer_count DESC, region_name

question: 统计每个商品分类下的商品数量。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY category_name

question: 计算每个商品分类的平均商品价格，保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY category_name

question: 所有已支付订单的总销售额是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid'

question: 订单取消率是多少？以百分比表示并保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders

question: 统计各种订单状态对应的商品总金额。
expected_sql: SELECT o.status, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS order_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

question: 每个订单平均包含多少种不同商品？保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_product_types FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: 每条订单明细的平均购买数量是多少？保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity FROM order_items

question: 哪些商品价格高于全部商品的平均价格？
expected_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC, name

question: 统计每个地区的新注册客户数量。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, COUNT(c.id) AS registered_customers FROM regions r LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY region_name

question: 统计每个地区的已支付销售额，按销售额降序排列。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, region_name

question: 统计每个商品分类的已支付销售额。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, category_name

question: 统计每种商品在已支付订单中的销售数量，按销量降序排列。
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC, product_name

question: 统计每种商品在已支付订单中的销售额，按销售额降序排列。
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, product_name

question: 找出已支付消费金额最高的5名客户。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS paid_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY paid_amount DESC, customer_name LIMIT 5

question: 统计每名客户的订单数量，包含从未下单的客户。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_name

question: 列出从未下过订单的客户。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY customer_name

question: 列出从未出现在任何订单中的商品。
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY product_name

question: 找出金额最高的已支付订单，并返回订单ID和金额。
expected_sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS order_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY order_amount DESC, order_id LIMIT 1

question: 计算每个地区已支付订单的平均订单金额，保留两位小数。
expected_sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.id, c.region_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.id, c.region_id) SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(AVG(ot.amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount FROM regions r JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY avg_order_amount DESC, region_name

question: 分别统计2024年和2025年的已支付销售额。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.created_at) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: 按月份统计2024年的已支付销售额。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 按月份统计2025年的订单数量。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 已支付订单从创建到支付平均需要多少小时？保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday(paid_at) - julianday(created_at)) * 24), 2) AS avg_payment_hours FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_at IS NOT NULL

question: 找出已支付销售额最高的10个日期。
expected_sql: SELECT date(o.created_at) AS order_date, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, order_date LIMIT 10

question: 按照星期几统计订单数量，其中0表示星期日。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', created_at) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday

question: 按订单创建小时统计订单数量。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%H', created_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

question: 统计2024年每个地区的已支付销售额。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, region_name

question: 统计2025年每个商品分类的已支付销售额。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, category_name

question: 按月份统计客户注册数量。
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 统计每个地区的已支付、取消和待支付订单数量。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY region_name

question: 找出订单总数超过10笔的客户。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 10 ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_name

question: 找出至少有2笔已支付订单的复购客户，并显示已支付订单数。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2 ORDER BY paid_order_count DESC, customer_name

question: 有多少笔已支付订单的订单金额超过2000元？
expected_sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_order_count FROM order_totals WHERE amount > 2000

question: 计算每个商品分类的已支付销售额占全部已支付销售额的百分比，保留两位小数。
expected_sql: WITH category_sales AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT name AS category_name, ROUND(100.0 * amount / SUM(amount) OVER (), 2) AS sales_percentage FROM category_sales ORDER BY sales_percentage DESC, category_name

question: 对各地区的已支付销售额进行排名。
expected_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT name AS region_name, ROUND(amount, 2) AS sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS sales_rank FROM region_sales ORDER BY sales_rank, region_name

question: 按月份计算已支付销售额以及累计销售额。
expected_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(amount, 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_sales FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY month

question: 找出2024年已支付销量最高的商品。
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 1

question: 计算每种商品的目录价格与历史订单单价之间的平均差额，保留两位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(p.price - AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price_difference FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price ORDER BY product_name

question: 计算每个地区订单的支付成功率，保留两位小数并按成功率降序排列。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.id), 2) AS payment_rate FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY payment_rate DESC, region_name
